modules.header_disposition: Literal source annotation only. Neither this annotation nor the containing directory supplies a current compile receipt; this map establishes source availability only.

supplied_support_deletion_lemmas.role: Restrict a finite-index PMF p to the subtype of indices a with p a nonzero, retaining the original probabilities. This deletes zero-mass indices without renormalizing positive probabilities.
Each retained atom has strictly positive real mass; uses nonzero mass and PMF.apply_ne_top.
Preserve the finite weighted sum for arbitrary real-valued f. Substitution f(a)=x(a)^n preserves each moment of the same fixed law.
Preserve the PMF pushforward to an arbitrary codomain after support deletion.

supplied_scalar_grouping_lemmas.definition: gridWeight w x a = sum over i of (if x i = a then w i else 0)
supplied_scalar_grouping_lemmas.role: Existing scalar equal-value aggregation; a new grouping definition is unnecessary.
For a finite real set A containing every x i, the subtype-indexed grouped sum of gridWeight w x a times a^n equals the original index sum of w i times (x i)^n, for arbitrary natural n.
If every x i belongs to A, grouped weight vanishes at every a outside A.
With w i = (p i).toReal, gridWeight w x a equals ((p.map x) a).toReal. This is the closest existing scalar PMF bridge.

supplied_physical_moment_and_correlation.definition: sum over a of (p a).toReal * x a ^ (k.choose 2)
supplied_physical_moment_and_correlation.role: The exponent changes with k while p and x remain constructor arguments.
Provides 0 < directedSurvival and directedSurvival <= 1. Equality with 1 is permitted and is compatible with the CM-T02 positive-axis constructor.
One whole configuration draw followed by one bank draw: p.bind (fun a => q.map (fun b => (a,b))). Correlations between forcing sites remain inside the configuration PMF.
Identifies the joint atom mass as the configuration mass times the bank mass.
Rewrites the finite joint weighted sum as the nested configuration/bank weighted sum.
Supplies the corresponding PMF bind association.

For 0 < k, equates the physical randomized legal comb moment with finiteBankMoment of configurationBankPMF nu (originalRegisterMeasure N p).toPMF and the directed-survival map of maskedNormalizedTree at the chosen pair i,j.

constructor_boundary.moment_definition: sum over x in mu.nodes of mu.weight x * x^n

uniform_theorem.statement_boundary: For arbitrary finite positive laws sigma,tau and an injective natural-exponent family of size 2*tau.nodes.card+1, equality of those moments implies sigma.nodes.card <= tau.nodes.card. This is a uniform theorem, not only an enumerated small example.

cap_five_endpoint.statement_boundary: If sigma has at least three nodes and tau has at most two, some exponent in capFiveLevels distinguishes their moments.

selected_closure_adapter_check.conclusion: These four selected embedded module bodies do not supply a typed physical-PMF-to-FinitePositiveLaw adapter. This is not a global absence claim about other sources or work in progress.

construction: Fix one finite-index PMF p and one positive scalar map x before quantifying over queried levels.
Use positiveSupportPMF p to delete only zero-mass indices.
Choose A as the distinct image of x on the retained positive-mass subtype. Do not use the full image including values reached only by zero-mass indices.
Define the candidate law's nodes as A and weights with existing gridWeight over the retained subtype, equivalently the real mass of its scalar PMF pushforward.
Prove node_pos from positivity of x, weight_pos from nonnegative summands and a positive image witness, and mass_one from PMF normalization plus the grouped n=0 identity.
Reconcile the subtype-indexed sum in gridWeight_moment with the Finset-membership sum in CM.moment.
Prove finiteBankMoment p x k = CM.moment mu (k.choose 2) using positiveSupportPMF_sum and gridWeight_moment. Compose with actual_randomized_legal_moment only under its supplied physical hypotheses.
proof_obligations_not_dispatched: A typed FinitePositiveLaw constructor in the combined source context.
Strict positivity of grouped weights at every selected distinct image value.
Normalization and subtype/Finset sum conversion at the actual Lean APIs.
One quantified moment-compatibility theorem connecting the physical readout to that same constructed law.
Source-owner selection and any separately authorized compiler admission.

fixed_law_and_scope_constraints: There is one fixed pushed-forward law mu for all queried k, not a family mu_k fitted separately to each queried level.

For the direct fixed-input construction, the configuration PMF, bank PMF, masks, scalar directed-survival map and grouping are fixed as k varies, so k.choose 2 changes only the exponent. Alternatively, these inputs may vary if their resulting scalar pushforward laws are proved equal to one common law for all selected k; fixed inputs are sufficient, not necessary.
Whole-configuration correlations stay inside the configuration PMF. Replacing it by a product of site marginals changes the law and is not justified by this reuse map.
Distinct positive-mass scalar survival values determine nodes.card. It is not automatically the number of banks, configurations, reticulations or a physical copy cap.
Survival value 1 is permitted. The accepted CM-T02 constructor requires positive nodes, while StrictlyInterior is a separate predicate.
Equal scalar survival values are aggregated; this does not identify a physical graph or individual bank assignments.
All source reuse must preserve the original hypotheses. Available declarations and matching bytes do not establish new combined-source compilation or physical endpoint acceptance.
